description: Adds a new check item to a specified Trello checklist; this action does not update existing check items.

inputSchema.description: Parameters to create a new check item on a checklist.

checked.description: Initial completion status: 'true' or 'false'. Defaults to unchecked.
checked.title: Checked

idChecklist.description: ID of the checklist to add the new check item to.
idChecklist.title: Id Checklist

name.description: Name/title for the new check item (1-16384 characters). Required by the Trello API for successful creation.
name.title: Name

pos.description: Position for the new check item: 'top', 'bottom', or a positive number. Defaults to bottom.
pos.title: Pos

inputSchema.title: AddChecklistsCheckItemsByIdChecklistRequest

name: add_checklists_check_items_by_id_checklist

AddChecklistsCheckItemsByIdChecklistResp.description: Response from Trello after adding a check item.

due.description: Due date for the check item in ISO 8601 format, if set.
due.title: Due

dueReminder.description: Due reminder setting in minutes before due date, if set.
dueReminder.title: Due Reminder

id.description: Unique identifier of the newly created check item.
id.title: Id

idChecklist.description: ID of the parent checklist containing this check item.
idChecklist.title: Id Checklist

idMember.description: ID of the member assigned to this check item, if any.
idMember.title: Id Member

limits.description: Rate limits and restrictions for the check item.
limits.title: Limits

name.description: The name/title of the check item.
name.title: Name

nameData.description: Additional name data including emoji information.
nameData.title: Name Data

pos.description: Position of the check item within the checklist.
pos.title: Pos
